palau.title: Flag of the Republic of Palau

colors.note: Represents the Pacific Ocean and the transition from foreign domination to self-government
The disc representing the full moon, considered the optimal time for human activity in Palauan tradition

desc:
- Light blue field with a large yellow disc slightly offset toward the hoist
- Adopted on 1 January 1981 when Palau achieved internal self-government under the Compact of Free Association
trivia:
- Although the colours and disc-on-blue layout resemble Japan's flag, the Palauan disc represents the moon rather than the sun and is deliberately off-centre
- The full moon is considered the best time for fishing, planting, and celebrations in Palauan tradition
- Palau is the world's twelfth-smallest country by population, with around 18,000 residents
